items.title: It just cost $2,553 to fill up 'Whiskers' — and Australians might bear the cost
items.description: On Australia's busiest freight route, it takes four shots of coffee, $2,553 of fuel and a little hair metal to keep the wheels of the economy turning.

items.title: James Valentine's year of living gratefully
items.description: Broadcaster James Valentine was offered two different treatments for his cancer, so he chose the one that let him keep doing what he loved. Australian Story followed Valentine over his final 12 months as he faced the end with courage, purpose and humour.

items.title: What we lose when big business buys up our favourite little pubs
items.description: From a tiny Riverina pub to a polished inner-city institution, Australia's local pubs are changing hands at record pace. As big money pours in, what happens to the communities that built them?

items.title: The year that changed the shape of Albanese's agenda
items.description: The prime minister's second term is now defined less by what he wants to do than by what unforeseen events will allow.

items.title: Charles wins over Trump, but fails to impress progressive mayor
items.description: King Charles's state visit to the United States hit a bump in New York when Mayor Zohran Mamdani said if the pair were to speak, he would "probably encourage him to return the Koh-i-Noor diamond".

items.title: 'This is not a game': Survivors disgusted by scam centre simulator games
items.description: Scam centre survivors say they are hurt by games that serialise scam compound experiences online, but one creator says he hopes people find the game "fun".

items.title: Australian taxpayers take on risk for major oil and gas projects
items.description: Australian governments take on risk to get major resource projects up and running, so why don't they take an equity stake?

items.title: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani
Kumanjayi Little Baby's grandfather thanks community, says time to 'let justice take its course'
items.description: The family of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby, whose body was found on the outskirts of Alice Springs on Thursday, has thanked the community for their support as tributes flow in from across the country.

items.title: Police pulled him over on his farm. He was tasered 30 seconds later
items.description: Disturbing cases of people wrongly tasered by police on their farm and at school has raised questions over whether officers are too reliant on the devices.

items.title: Brisbane Lions coach slams 'hero' parent after whiteboard leak
items.description: Chris Fagan has expressed his disappointment after the leaking of confidential Brisbane Lions notes on Essendon players.

items.title: Carlton blows another half-time lead as Voss pins blame on defensive effort
items.description: Carlton coach Michael Voss has said his side's defence is not up to standard after the Blues suffered another second-half collapse on Saturday.

items.title: Emotional scenes as Rooster returns after 1,337 days out with illness
items.description: The Roosters hang on for a 38-24 win over the Broncos, as Cody Ramsey plays his first NRL game in almost four years.

items.title: It's your Sunday serve of spelling stumpers
items.description: You lot take your spelling seriously. Repeat after me: It's just an internet quiz. It's just an internet quiz.

items.title: How a song about a jailbreak inspired Robert Forster's debut novel
items.description: The Go-Betweens frontman spent years developing the story, which follows a pair of musicians on the run from the law as they try to clear their names.

items.title: Why Dee Salmin thinks her book could end relationships
items.description: Podcaster Dee Salmin says people should steer clear of traditional dating advice and focus more on themselves.

items.title: Liberal Party retains the seat of Nepean in by-election
items.description: Anthony Marsh wins the Nepean by-election, retaining the seat for the Liberal Party.

items.title: How a 'loner' went from a life of privilege to Bondi gunman
items.description: Sajid Akram was a man of unusual secrecy — even to his own family. New details uncovered by Background Briefing shed light on his downward spiral into violence.

items.title: Israeli police video shows attack on nun in Jerusalem
items.description: Israeli police release a video showing what eyewitnesses say was an attack by a Jewish man on a nun near Jerusalem's Old City. Police say the suspect, a 36-year-old man, was later arrested.

items.title: Who's really in charge in Iran?
items.description: There's growing belief it's not the supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei but Ahmad Vahidi, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps boss and ideological hardliner. So are the generals really in charge in Iran?

items.title: US to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany amid Trump spat with Merz
items.description: The United States is withdrawing 5,000 troops from NATO ally Germany amid a growing a rift between the nations' leaders over the Iran war.

items.title: Second of two new Spirit of Tasmania ferries arrives in Geelong
items.description: Following a seven-week journey from Scotland, the Spirit of Tasmania V has arrived in Geelong. It will undergo gantry testing tomorrow before being temporarily relocated to Station Pier in Melbourne.

items.title: Polar blast and snow to follow record May heat over south-east Australia
items.description: Just weeks from winter, and south-east Australia is still enjoying summertime warmth.

items.title: Why this cattle farmer is flooding his property with salt water
items.description: More than half a century ago, lush wetlands along the Queensland coastline were cut off from the ocean as farmers built physical barriers to stop salt water flowing into their land. Now, conservation groups and traditional owners are restoring tidal flows and bringing life back to the land.

items.title: Sabotage and violence alleged on major Brisbane rail project
items.description: Queensland's inquiry into the CFMEU has revealed Cross River Rail was plagued by years of interference. Here are the key takeaways from this week's hearings.
